knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The client buys the finished result, with certainty that the work is checked at each stage. The hourly rate, van and tile cutter are inputs, not the outcome.
A guarantee or fix-first promise must be something you can deliver and afford. The lesson says not to promise terms you cannot keep.
A sales page claim about licensing must be checked against the state rule for the type and value of the work before it is relied on in an offer.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
